prospective_selection.ranking: Ascending SHA256(UTF-8 seed + LF + exact strict-FEN first four fields); retain first source game for duplicates.
prospective_selection.eligibility: Standard game; every mainline move legal; valid final position with legal moves; final actual EP square absent before serialization; unique first-four-field FEN; exclude all recorded historical registries including frozen unused tails and new164selection; no engine evaluation.
prospective_selection.allocation: First4 AA, following1024 serial SPRT opening pairs; all1028positions reserved together, no outcome-based reselection.

limitations: Standard opening suite at16plies, not an automatically balanced set. First upstream PGN headers identify Stockfish versus Stockfish dated2013.11.02; no human-opening-distribution claim. No engine evaluation or outcome filtering; equal-color pairs required. Exact future engines/clocks/protocol remain to be preregistered.
